headline: APEC Summit. Trump said he wants to hold a separate meeting with Putin
summary: US President Donald Trump said he would like to hold a separate meeting with Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, if the opportunity arises. He spoke on the sidelines of the APEC summit.
why: US-Russia relations influence sanctions, energy markets and geopolitical risk premiums that investors track closely.
original_headline: Саммит АТЭС. Трамп заявил, что хочет провести отдельную встречу с Путиным
